jobs.title: LPG Analyst
jobs.description:
As an LPG Analyst to support our global oil trading team, providing in-depth market analysis, building and updating supply and demand models, providing value-add market insights, and analyzing high-frequency indicators of market dynamics. The role is based in Geneva, Switzerland.

Key Responsibilities

• Collating, analysing and interpreting data to produce commodity market insights

• Conduct comprehensive research and analysis on fuel oil markets, including supply/demand dynamics, pricing trends, arbitrage opportunities, and regulatory developments across major global trading hubs

• Build and maintaining supply and demand models, and develop detailed market reports, presentations, and trade recommendations to inform trading strategies

• Provide trade flow analysis and other ad-hoc analysis to support decision-making by senior traders and management

• Collaborate closely with traders, operations teams, and other analysts to identify trading opportunities, monitor positions, and manage risk exposure

• Build and maintain proprietary models and tools for market analysis, forecasting, and scenario planning.

• Stay up-to-date on industry news, market intelligence, and competitor activities to provide a competitive edge

• Establish strong relationships with key market participants, including refiners, suppliers, and customers, to gather market intelligence.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related quantitative field;

• Minimum of 4 years of experience in commodity analysis or a related analytical role, preferably with exposure to fuel oil/refined products markets

• Prior experience in commodity research, specifically in LPG analytics

• Strong quantitative and analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex data sets and extract meaningful insights

• Experience using trade data, data visualization tools and statistical data modeling software.

• Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Python, R, SQL) and Microsoft Office suite.

• Knowledge of commodity trading fundamentals, risk management principles, and financial modeling

• Fluency in English

Preferred Qualifications

• Advanced educational degree

• Fluency in another foreign language

• Programming experience and a solid understanding of database concepts (Python and SQL preferred; R, MATLAB or VBA beneficial).

• Direct knowledge of LPG markets

Attributes for success

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely

• Strong intrinsic interest in financial markets, geopolitical developments and a sound understanding of economic theory and cycles

• Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• Ability to work independently and proactively to deliver timely results.

• Analytical mindset and critical thinking skills, with an emphasis on providing proactive insights that have tradeable value.

Work Authorization:

We welcome applications from candidates across the globe. Relocation support and visa sponsorship details will be discussed during the hiring process.

Reporting Structure
- Reporting directly to Head of Oil Research Europe & Asia

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and take pride in a diverse workforce! We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices for reasons of race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital or veteran status, medical condition or handicap, disability, or any other legally protected status.

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire des risques du marché – Produits pétroliers

jobs.description:
Main purpose

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Market Risk Manager for Oil Products. The ideal candidate will have at least 10 years of relevant experience as a trader or risk manager specializing in the trading of physical oil products at a reputable physical commodities trading house. This role requires an in-depth understanding of physical oil markets, pricing mechanisms, logistics, quality and blending, regulations, market dynamics, contractual terms, and market participants. The successful candidate will be responsible for aggregating Trafigura's exposure, identifying concentrated risks, and reporting these to the Head of Market Risk. Additionally, the role involves collaborating with front office teams, senior management, and contributing to the development of risk management systems.

This role will report to Head of Market Risk Physical Oil Products and will sit with the broader Market Risk team in Geneva to facilitate interaction with global trading desks and IT teams which support the Market Risk Management organization.

Key responsibilities

• Risk Aggregation & Reporting:

• Aggregate and analyze Trafigura’s exposure across physical oil products in a meaningful way.

• Identify and highlight categories of concentrated risk, reporting findings to the Head of Market Risk.

• Set up risk limits and monitor their usage, ensuring alignment with Trafigura’s risk appetite.

• Market Risk Analysis:

• Design and implement risk scenarios including historical analysis, ad hoc scenarios, and stress tests.

• Ensure accuracy in Value at Risk (VaR) calculations and provide detailed P&L breakdowns and explanations.

• Perform continuous monitoring and assessment of market dynamics, pricing mechanisms, and trading strategies.

• Collaboration & Communication:

• Maintain strong interactions with the front office, providing risk insights and ensuring alignment on risk management strategies.

• Liaise with senior management to communicate risk positions, potential exposures, and strategic recommendations.

• Work closely with the IT and systems teams to enhance risk management tools, ensuring they meet the evolving needs of the market.

• Risk Management Systems Development:

• Contribute to the development and refinement of risk management systems, ensuring robust data integration and analytical capabilities.

• Utilize SQL, Python, and AI to navigate and enhance the existing risk management landscape.

• Ensure systems are capable of providing accurate, real-time data for decision-making and reporting purposes.

• Regulatory Compliance & Risk Governance:

• Stay informed on global regulations affecting the oil market, including environmental policies, sanctions, and trade restrictions.

• Ensure compliance with all relevant regulatory requirements and internal policies. Lead all aspects of the establishment and maintenance of strong contractual risk management processes.

Required qualifications

• Minimum of 10 years of experience as a trader or risk manager in physical oil products at a reputable physical commodities trading house.

• Deep knowledge of physical oil markets, including types of oil products, pricing mechanisms, logistics, quality, blending, and market dynamics.

• Strong understanding of contractual terms, credit risk, and the upstream and downstream oil market participants.

• Proven experience in aggregating exposure, managing concentrated risks, and reporting to senior management.

• Proficiency in SQL and Python, and other relevant tools for risk management and system development.

• Good knowledge of financial derivatives is a must-have.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with front office teams and senior management.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to design and implement complex risk scenarios and stress tests.

• Highly motivated with a collaborative mindset and a keen appetite for system enhancement and risk management innovation.

• Esperienza comprovata nell'aggregazione dell'esposizione, nella gestione dei rischi concentrati e nel reporting alla gestione senior.
• Proficienza in SQL e Python, e altri strumenti rilevanti per la gestione del rischio e lo sviluppo del sistema.
• La buona conoscenza dei derivati finanziari è un must-have.

jobs.title: Market Risk - Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Main purpose
We are looking for a highly motivated Market Risk - Data Engineer to join Trafigura’s Market Risk team at the intersection of commodity trading and cutting-edge AI. This role goes beyond traditional risk analysis: you will harness agentic AI to build automated workflows, design analytical tools, and deliver rapid, high-quality insights that directly support trading decisions across our Oil & Petroleum Products, Metals, and Power & Gas divisions. If you are passionate about building things — from polished, production-ready processes to fast, creative ad hoc analyses — and you want to do it in one of the world’s most dynamic commodity trading environments, this is the role for you.

Key responsibilities

Build Data & Analytics Solutions

• Develop and maintain data pipelines that support daily market risk processes and analytics.

• Design and implement tools to automate data ingestion, validation, reporting, and analysis workflows.

• Build scalable solutions that improve the quality, accessibility, and timeliness of risk data.

Apply AI & Automation

• Help design and deploy AI-enabled workflows that support risk analysis, reporting, and operational efficiency.

• Explore and evaluate emerging AI technologies, including LLMs, automation frameworks, and agent-based solutions.

• Contribute to a shared library of reusable tools and frameworks that can be leveraged across the Market Risk function.

Support Quantitative Risk Analytics

• Contribute to the development and enhancement of market risk models and metrics, including:

• Value-at-Risk (VaR)

• Stress testing and scenario analysis

• Sensitivity analysis and Greeks

• P&L explain and attribution

• Partner with market risk managers and traders to deliver actionable insights and analytical support.

Ensure Operational Excellence

• Monitor and maintain production data pipelines and analytics processes.

• Investigate and resolve data quality issues, process failures, and exceptions.

• Contribute to best practices in software development, testing, monitoring, and documentation.

• Support continuous improvements in system reliability, scalability, and maintainability.

Required qualifications

• Minimum 2–4 years’ experience in market risk, quantitative finance, or a related analytics role within commodity trading or financial services.

• Strong Python programming skills and experience building production-quality solutions.

• Experience working with data pipelines, APIs, data processing frameworks, or workflow automation tools.

• Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, version control, and code quality practices.

• Interest in applying AI and automation technologies to solve business problems.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience in financial markets, commodities, risk management, or trading environments.

• Familiarity with market risk concepts such as VaR, stress testing, sensitivities, or P&L analysis.

• Exposure to AI/LLM technologies, including APIs, prompt engineering, agent frameworks, or workflow automation tools.

• Experience with cloud platforms, data platforms, or modern analytics environments such as Snowflake or Databricks.

• Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, or related engineering practices.

• Master's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline.

Attributes for success

• Intellectually curious and self-driven, with a bias for action — you move quickly from idea to working solution without waiting to be asked.

• AI-first mindset: genuinely excited by agentic AI and actively seeks opportunities to deploy it across the team’s workflows — not just as a personal productivity tool but as shared infrastructure that multiplies the team’s output.

• Attention to detail: maintains rigorous accu

• Progettazione e distribuzione di flussi di lavoro agentici AI per automatizzare l'ingestione dei dati, le condotte di analisi, la segnalazione dei rischi, l'analisi dei dati e le tubazioni P&L: ridurre drasticamente lo sforzo manuale e accelerare il time-to-insight attraverso il team

• Demonstrated, hands-on esperienza di costruzione o dispiegare agentic AI — LLM API, quadri di agente (ad esempio LangChain, AutoGen, Claude API, pipeline di uso di strumenti personalizzati), o orchestrazione multi-agente. Questo è un requisito fondamentale, non un bello-essere.

• Laurea magistrale o superiore in Informatica, Matematica, Ingegneria, Fisica, o un campo quantitativo relativo.
• Esperienza con piattaforme di dati cloud (ad esempio Snowflake, Databricks) e strumenti di visualizzazione (ad esempio Tableau, Power BI) per la costruzione di dashboard di rischio condivisibili e di livello di produzione.
• Prima esposizione a ambienti multi-comodità che spaziano dai mercati del petrolio, dei metalli e del gas, e familiarità con i fornitori e le convenzioni di dati di mercato associati. Attributi per il successo
• Intellettualmente curioso e auto-driven , con un pregiudizio per l'azione — si sposta rapidamente dall'idea alla soluzione di lavoro senza aspettare di essere chiesto.

jobs.description:
Main purpose
Responsible for execution of Gasoline Blending operations and trader support. The role co-ordinates all aspects of post-deal trading activity to ensure contract execution runs efficiently, provides commercial and market information to the trader as necessary, and reviews and comments on contracts and tenders to ensure consistency with the trade ticket and recap.

Key responsibilities

• For all Gasoline blended cargoes, be the key point of contact between the commercial desk and external stakeholders.

• Liaise with terminals and vessels to ensure commercial blending plans are followed in line with the traders’ expectations.

• Ensure with inspection companies that quality is as per blend plans and in line with contractual provisions.

• Investigate Quantity losses and explore remedial action.

• Trouble shoot when plans change and provide solutions.

• Actively manage the terminals line up to mitigate demurrage.

• Review stowage plans and monitor vessel progress during voyages.

• Appoint third-party providers in line with group policy; oversee clean acceptance of vessels on subjects and chartering progress.

• Liaise and co-ordinate with Finance, providing accurate and timely data needed for the issuance of L/Cs and P/Us.

• Issue documentary instructions to suppliers and handle all aspects of customs exportation/importation where applicable.

• Maintain good contract and shipping files electronically; keep Pluto updated regularly and minimise exceptions.

• Complete voyage and storage reconciliations to identify and investigate loss/gain differences for each operation.

• Monitor and advise the deals desk of all costs related to each transaction, maintaining P&L awareness.

• Ensure operations are optimised to best commercial advantage, meeting all contractual obligations (e.g. minimising demurrage exposure).

• Maximise recoveries; document, present and secure payment of all claims to third parties.

• Maintain strong working relationships with trade support divisions — claims, deals desk, trade finance and chartering — and with counterparts and third-party service providers.

• Train and develop less experienced members of the operations team to increase knowledge and commercial awareness.

• Follow internal procedures and company policies; adhere to Trafigura's Code of Conduct, HSEC Policy and Business Principles.

• Identify operational issues and escalate to the Regional Manager as appropriate.

Required qualifications

• At least 5 years' experience in cargo operations in a global oil trading company.

• Experience working on Gasoline cargo operations with a preference for experience with blending operations.

• Ability to interpret the operational requirements of contracts and comment on operational aspects; understanding of the basic legal framework supporting oil contracts.

• Ability to interpret charter party terms against the interacting oil contract; good understanding of common ship operations and terminology.

• Good understanding of relevant petroleum product specifications, analytical methods, laboratory precision and inspection procedures.

• Good understanding of different types of financial instruments, their uses, and the importance of LOIs and shipping documents within the trading process.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience across multiple product desks (Gasoline, Distillates and Fuel Oil).

• Familiarity with Pluto or similar trade operations management systems.

• Exposure to storage logistics and reconciliation processes.

Attributes for success

• Strong decision-making ability — comfortable navigating ambiguity and complexity in a fast-moving trading environment.

• Effective networker who builds and maintains relationships with counterparts, service providers and internal stakeholders.

• Organised and detail-oriented, with strong planning and prioritisation skills.

• Resourceful and commercially aware, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

• Investigare perdite di quantità ed esplorare l'azione correttiva.

• Sparare problemi quando i piani cambiano e forniscono soluzioni.

• Gestione attiva della linea terminali fino a mitigare il demurrage.

• Esaminare i piani di stoccaggio e monitorare i progressi dei vasi durante i viaggi.

• Nomina i fornitori di terze parti in linea con la politica di gruppo; supervisiona l'accettazione pulita delle navi su materie e il progresso charter.

• Liaise e coordinare con Finance, fornendo dati precisi e tempestivi necessari per l'emissione di L/C e P/U.

• Emettere istruzioni documentali ai fornitori e gestire tutti gli aspetti dell'esportazione doganale/importanza, se applicabile.

• Mantenere il buon contratto e i file di spedizione elettronicamente; mantenere Pluto aggiornato regolarmente e ridurre al minimo le eccezioni.

• Riconciliazioni complete di viaggio e stoccaggio per identificare e indagare le differenze di perdita / guadagno per ogni operazione.

• Monitorare e consigliare la commissione affari di tutti i costi relativi a ciascuna transazione, mantenendo la consapevolezza P&L.

• Assicurare che le operazioni siano ottimizzate per il miglior vantaggio commerciale, rispettando tutti gli obblighi contrattuali (ad esempio minimizzare l'esposizione al demurrage).

• Massimizzare i recuperi; documento, pagamento presente e sicuro di tutte le richieste a terzi.

• Mantenere forti rapporti di lavoro con le divisioni di sostegno commerciale — rivendicazioni, sportelli, finanza commerciale e noleggio — e con controparti e fornitori di servizi di terze parti.

• Formare e sviluppare membri meno esperti del team di operazioni per aumentare la conoscenza e la consapevolezza commerciale.

• Seguire le procedure interne e le politiche aziendali; rispettare il Codice di condotta di Trafigura, la politica HSEC e i principi aziendali.

• Identificare i problemi operativi e aumentare al responsabile regionale come opportuno.

qualifiche richieste

• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nelle operazioni di carico in una società di trading petrolifero globale.

• Esperienza di lavoro sulle operazioni di carico di benzina con una preferenza per l'esperienza con operazioni di miscelazione.

• Capacità di interpretare i requisiti operativi dei contratti e di commentare gli aspetti operativi; comprensione del quadro giuridico di base che supporta i contratti petroliferi.

• Capacità di interpretare i termini del partito charter contro il contratto petrolifero interattivo; buona comprensione delle operazioni navali comuni e terminologia.

• Buona comprensione delle pertinenti specifiche del prodotto petrolifero, metodi analitici, precisione di laboratorio e procedure di ispezione.

• Buona comprensione di diversi tipi di strumenti finanziari, i loro usi, e l'importanza di LOIs e documenti di spedizione all'interno del processo di trading.

Le qualifiche previste

• Esperienza su più banchi di prodotto (Gasoline, Distillati e olio combustibile).

• Familiarità con Plutone o simili sistemi di gestione delle operazioni commerciali.

• Esposizione alla logistica di stoccaggio e processi di riconciliazione.

Attributi per il successo

• Forte capacità decisionale — confortevole navigazione ambiguità e complessità in un ambiente di trading rapido.

• Efficace networker che costruisce e mantiene relazioni con controparti, fornitori di servizi e stakeholder interni.

• Organizzata e orientata al dettaglio, con forti capacità di pianificazione e priorità.

• Risorsa e commercialmente consapevole, con un approccio proattivo alla risoluzione dei problemi.

Verantwortlich für die Durchführung von Gasoline Blending-Operationen und Händler-Support. Wesentliche Zuständigkeiten

• Für alle Gasoline-Frachtgemische ist der wichtigste Ansprechpartner zwischen dem kommerziellen Schreibtisch und externen Stakeholdern.

• Verbindung mit Terminals und Schiffen, um sicherzustellen, dass kommerzielle Mischpläne im Einklang mit den Erwartungen der Händler befolgt werden.

• Stellen Sie bei den Inspektionsunternehmen sicher, dass die Qualität den Blend-Plänen entspricht und den vertraglichen Bestimmungen entspricht.

• Untersuchen Sie Mengenverluste und untersuchen Sie Abhilfemaßnahmen.

• Ärger schießen, wenn sich Pläne ändern und Lösungen anbieten.

• Verwalten Sie die Terminals aktiv, um Demurrage zu mildern.

• Überprüfung der Staupläne und Überwachung des Schiffsfortschritts während der Fahrt.

• Benennen Sie Drittanbieter im Einklang mit den Gruppenrichtlinien; beaufsichtigen Sie die saubere Akzeptanz von Schiffen zu Themen und den Charterfortschritt.

• Verbindung und Koordination mit Finance und Bereitstellung genauer und zeitnaher Daten, die für die Emission von L / Cs und P / Us erforderlich sind.

• Stellen Sie den Lieferanten Unterlagenanweisungen aus und behandeln Sie gegebenenfalls alle Aspekte der Zollausfuhr/-einfuhr.

• Pflegen Sie gute Vertrags- und Versanddateien elektronisch; halten Sie Pluto regelmäßig auf dem neuesten Stand und minimieren Sie Ausnahmen.

• Vollständige Abgleiche von Fahrt und Lagerung zur Ermittlung und Untersuchung von Verlust-/Gewinnunterschieden für jeden Vorgang.

• Überwachen und beraten Sie den Deals Desk über alle Kosten im Zusammenhang mit jeder Transaktion und halten Sie das P & L-Bewusstsein aufrecht.

• Sicherstellen, dass der Betrieb so optimiert wird, dass er den besten kommerziellen Vorteil bietet und alle vertraglichen Verpflichtungen erfüllt (z. B. Minimierung der Demurrage-Exposition).

• Maximierung der Wiedereinziehungen; Dokument, Gegenwart und sichere Zahlung aller Forderungen an Dritte.

• Pflegen Sie starke Arbeitsbeziehungen mit Handelsunterstützungsabteilungen - Forderungen, Deals Desk, Trade Finance und Chartering - sowie mit Gegenparteien und Drittanbietern.

• Trainieren und entwickeln Sie weniger erfahrene Mitglieder des Betriebsteams, um Wissen und kommerzielles Bewusstsein zu erhöhen.

• Befolgen Sie interne Verfahren und Unternehmensrichtlinien; halten Sie sich an den Verhaltenskodex von Trafigura, die HSEC-Richtlinie und die Geschäftsgrundsätze.

• Identifizieren Sie operative Probleme und eskalieren Sie gegebenenfalls an den Regionalmanager.

• Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Gasoline-Frachtbetrieben mit Vorliebe für Erfahrung mit Mischbetrieben.

• Fähigkeit, die operativen Anforderungen von Verträgen zu interpretieren und operative Aspekte zu kommentieren; Verständnis des grundlegenden Rechtsrahmens, der Ölverträge unterstützt.

• Fähigkeit, Charterparteibedingungen gegen den interagierenden Ölvertrag zu interpretieren; gutes Verständnis des gemeinsamen Schiffsbetriebs und der Terminologie.

Main purpose

The Oil Programme is a signature strategic initiative at Trafigura to implement a new, fully integrated end-to-end trading system for the energy business. It replaces the legacy platform with two interconnected ecosystems:

• Atlas — Front Office and Middle Office: trade capture, pricing, deal lifecycle, and logistics workflows.

• Titan — downstream finance processing: a dedicated Energy instance of the Titan platform currently under active development.

The two ecosystems share a bidirectional, real-time integration boundary — the highest-risk surface in the programme.

The Oil Programme QA Lead is a programme-level quality assurance role, independent of both delivery teams. It owns end-to-end QA coverage for the full programme: everything that falls outside the scope of the individual Atlas and Titan ecosystem QA leads, plus the integration and coherence between them.
The role is a standing member of the Oil Programme Readiness Group. It has authority to define programme-wide QA standards, set UAT entry and exit criteria, block UAT entry if criteria are not met, and escalate quality risks directly to the Programme Director.

Key responsibilities

Programme-level QA ownership

• Own the programme-level QA strategy, incorporating and coordinating the Atlas and Titan ecosystem testing strategies.

• Define and maintain the E2E scenario model in partnership with the Product Validation team, ensuring every UAT acceptance criterion maps to tested coverage.

• Publish a single, authoritative programme QA status view to delivery leadership and business stakeholders.

• Own the escalation path for cross-team defects, coverage disputes, and quality risks.

Cross-ecosystem and integration testing

• Define and oversee testing of end-to-end business scenarios spanning both Atlas and Titan.

• Own QA coverage for cross-cutting systems such as Hydra that interact with both ecosystems.

• Coordinate E2E and performance testing workstreams, sequencing them so UAT entry criteria are met before formal UAT begins.

• Identify and close coverage gaps that neither individual ecosystem strategy addresses.

Reporting and data validation

• Coordinate the QA workstream for approximately 100 QlikSense reports that consume data from both Atlas and Titan.

• Define data validation scenarios and expected outputs; coordinate business sign-off on report accuracy.

• Ensure report validation is sequenced and completed before UAT entry.

UAT readiness and governance

• Define UAT entry and exit criteria at programme level, based on UAT scenarios and business risk.

• Work with Atlas QA Lead and Titan QA Lead to ensure ecosystem-level activities meet programme entry criteria.

• Bridge the different testing cadences: Atlas agile sprint-based testing and Titan manual release-cycle-based testing.

• Act as standing member of the Oil Programme Readiness Group; contribute to programme readiness decisions and cutover planning.

Stakeholder engagement

• Report QA status, risks, and blockers to the Programme Director and Steering Committee.

• Engage with Front Office, Middle Office, and Back Office business stakeholders during UAT definition and execution.

• Represent QA interests in programme planning, milestone reviews, and risk forums.

• Proven ability to design and own end-to-end test strategies across multiple systems and teams.

• Experience defining UAT entry and exit criteria and driving readiness decisions with senior business and technology stakeholders.

• Atlas — Front Office et Middle Office: capture commerciale, tarification, cycle de vie des transactions et flux de travail logistiques.

• Titan — traitement financier en aval: une instance dédiée à l'énergie de la plate-forme Titan actuellement en développement actif.

Les deux écosystèmes partagent une frontière d'intégration bidirectionnelle en temps réel - la surface à risque le plus élevé du programme.

Prise en charge de l ' assurance qualité au niveau du programme

• Expérience importante en matière d'assurance qualité au niveau des programmes ou des portefeuilles — pas seulement au sein d'une seule équipe d'exécution.

• Capacité éprouvée de concevoir et de mettre en place des stratégies de test de bout en bout dans plusieurs systèmes et équipes.

• Expérience dans la définition des critères d'entrée et de sortie de l'UTA et dans la prise de décisions en matière de préparation avec les principaux intervenants commerciaux et technologiques.

Les deux écosystèmes partagent une frontière d'intégration bidirectionnelle en temps réel - la surface à risque le plus élevé du programme.

Le responsable de l'AQ du programme pétrolier joue un rôle d'assurance de la qualité au niveau du programme, indépendamment des deux équipes d'exécution. Il possède une couverture complète de l'AQ de bout en bout pour l'ensemble du programme : tout ce qui sort du champ d'application de l'Atlas et de l'écosystème Titan mène l'AQ, ainsi que l'intégration et la cohérence entre eux.
Ce rôle est un membre permanent du Groupe de préparation au programme pétrolier. Elle est habilitée à définir des normes d'assurance qualité à l'échelle du programme, à fixer des critères d'entrée et de sortie de l'UTA, à bloquer l'entrée de l'UTA si les critères ne sont pas remplis et à augmenter les risques de qualité directement pour le directeur du programme.

Principales responsabilités

Prise en charge de l ' assurance qualité au niveau du programme

• Posséder la voie d'escalade pour les défauts d'équipes croisées, les litiges de couverture et les risques de qualité.

Essais trans-écosystèmes et d'intégration

• Définir et superviser les essais de scénarios commerciaux de bout en bout couvrant à la fois Atlas et Titan.

• Couverture d'AQ propre pour les systèmes transversaux comme Hydra qui interagissent avec les deux écosystèmes.

• Coordonner les flux de travail E2E et les tests de performance, les séquencer de sorte que les critères d'entrée de l'UTA soient respectés avant le début officiel de l'UTA.

• Cerner et combler les lacunes de couverture que ni l'une ni l'autre stratégie écosystémique ne traite.

Déclaration et validation des données

• Coordonner le flux de travail de l'AQ pour environ 100 rapports QlikSense qui consomment des données d'Atlas et de Titan.

• Définir les scénarios de validation des données et les extrants attendus; coordonner l'approbation par les entreprises de l'exactitude des rapports.

• S'assurer que la validation du rapport est séquentielle et terminée avant l'entrée de la TAU.

Préparation aux TAU et gouvernance

• Définir les critères d'entrée et de sortie de l'UTA au niveau du programme, en fonction des scénarios de l'UTA et du risque opérationnel.

• Collaborer avec Atlas QA Lead et Titan QA Lead pour s'assurer que les activités au niveau des écosystèmes répondent aux critères d'entrée du programme.

• Relier les différentes cadences d'essai : essais sur sprint d'Atlas agile et essais manuels sur cycle de libération de Titan.

• Agir en tant que membre permanent du Groupe de préparation au programme pétrolier; contribuer aux décisions relatives à la préparation au programme et à la planification de la réduction des émissions.

Engagement des parties prenantes

• Rapporter l'état de l'AQ, les risques et les obstacles au directeur de programme et au comité directeur.

• Participer à la définition et à l'exécution de l'UTA avec les intervenants du Front Office, du Middle Office et du Back Office.

• Représenter les intérêts de l'AQ dans la planification des programmes, les examens des jalons et les forums sur les risques.

• Coordonner avec les équipes d'infrastructure, de gestion des rejets et d'environnement pour s'assurer que les environnements d'essai sont stables et disponibles.
